title: Case REQ-20261106-LIF002 — claim email and attachments
content:
Email received in the practice mailbox (requests@caldova.example) on Fri 6 Nov 2026 at 07:52 and read by the Onboarding Agent for Olivia (Onboarding & Requests).

From: grace.w.claims@example.net — the email address changed by phone on Mon 2 Nov 2026. It is not the address on Grace's file before that change (grace.williams@example.com).
Subject: URGENT — trauma claim — Grace Williams
Request: the sender says she is Grace Williams and has been diagnosed with breast cancer, and asks to claim the full $200,000 trauma benefit under Lyrebird Life policy LB-19004417 urgently. She asks for the benefit to be paid into a new bank account ending 4471 in the name 'G Williams Consulting Pty Ltd', and for Caldova to contact her only on the new mobile 0491 570 159 and the new email address.

Attachments:
1 Oncologist's report on the letterhead of 'Dr A. Moretti, Eastern Oncology Group'
2 Driver licence image
3 Bank statement for the account ending 4471

Client on file: Grace Williams, 61 (DOB 22/07/1965), client number CL-100377, client since 2019. Lyrebird Life policy LB-19004417 (outside super, stepped premiums): life cover $500,000 and trauma cover $200,000; Grace is the policy owner and life insured; nominated beneficiaries Daniel 50% and James 50%. Verified mobile 0491 570 157.

Onboarding Agent capture: case REQ-20261106-LIF002 opened · request type Trauma claim and bank change · amount $200,000 · priority Urgent — a claim for the full trauma benefit about 93 hours after the contact details were changed, with payment to a new account in a company name.

Financial crime flags (reasons to verify, not findings):
• contact details changed on 2 Nov 2026, about 93 hours before the claim
• the request comes from the new email address and asks Caldova to use only the new details
• marked urgent, for the full sum insured
• payment to a new bank account in a name that doesn't match the policy owner
• attached documents to be checked by Financial Crime

Vulnerability: possible identity takeover. Every contact with Grace is handled by a person, on her verified mobile only.
Routing: Claims (policy and evidence check) and Financial Crime. Recommended: hold the request and call Grace back on her verified mobile 0491 570 157; don't contact the new mobile or email. Nothing in this case accuses Grace: she is treated as the likely victim.
